newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLAIPEDA PORT HANDLES 6.459 MLN TONNES IN 5 MO.
newsitem.headline: KLAIPEDA PORT HANDLES 6.459 MLN TONNES IN 5 MO.

text.p: Lithuania's port of Klaipeda said on Tuesday that it handled 6.459 tonnes of cargoes in the first five months of the year compared to 5.33 million tonnes in the same period in 1996.
It also said that the volume of cargo handled in May inched up to 1.26 million tonnes compared to 1.19 million tonnes in April.

"The volume of cargoes handled in May could be have been higher but Klaipedos Nafta handled 33 percent less oil products in May compared to the same period last year," the chief of the port's marketing department, Antanas Chyzhas, told Reuters.
Klaipedos Nafta handled 189,000 tonnes of oil products in May 1997 compared to 570,000 tonnes in the same period in 1996, Chyzhas said.

"Other operators at the port of Kalipeda handled considerably more cargoes this May and their reloading volume stood at 1.07 million tonnes compared to 830,000 tonnes in the same period last year," Chyzhas said.
He also said that the main cargoes handled in May were metals and fertilisers.
